output.content:
## Inference Runtime Abstraction

Phase-2A is now framed as an inference runtime abstraction layer, not only an
LMF-to-vLLM migration.

```text
Cognitive Runtime Freeze
  -> ModelBackend Contract
  -> Inference Runtime Abstraction
  -> Replaceable Backend
```

Current roadmap:

- Phase-2A.1: Inference Trace Layer
- Phase-2A.2: Backend / artifact equivalence experiments
- Phase-2B: additional inference backends such as TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, or
  external API adapters

See `docs/inference-trace-layer-design.md` and
`docs/phase2a-equivalence-matrix.md`.

Trace output can be enabled in the inference benchmark entry points with
`--trace-output`, which writes append-only JSONL records outside the frozen
Phase-1 Runtime.
